description: Power BI's built-in waterfall handles category movement. It does not handle a bridge: an opening anchor, drivers that explain the movement, intermediate checkpoints a finance reader expects, and a closing total. Without those, a P&L walk is a row of floating bars and the reader has to reconstruct the story themselves. Waterfall Advanced adds the one thing that changes that: control over what each bar means. Mark a row as a total, a subtotal or a driver, and the chart draws the bridge your finance team already has in their heads. BUILT FOR P&L WALKS • Totals, subtotals and drivers as distinct bar types, from a column in your model • Intermediate checkpoints — Net Revenue, Gross Profit, EBITDA — drawn from zero • Horizontal or vertical, because line-item names read better down the side • A target line on the anchor bars, with its own label and figure, drawn above the bars • Drivers far from the rest are flagged automatically • Summary cards: opening, closing, variance %, biggest gain, biggest loss READABLE ON PURPOSE • Style templates in one click: Classic, Modern, Soft, One colour (from a base colour you choose) and Dark background • A colour-blind safe palette and hatched decreases, so a rise and a fall still read printed in black and white • Conditional formatting on bar colour through the native fx dialog, or a hex colour per row from your model • The measure's own format —…
